summary.text: Angelo J. Morinello is an Assemblymember who was elected on November 8, 2016, and represents the 145th Assembly District, which includes parts of Niagara and Erie Counties.
His official biography describes him as a Vietnam combat veteran, lawyer and retired Niagara Falls City Court judge.

paragraphs.text: Morinello's Assembly biography describes him as a lifelong resident of Western New York and a retired judge who served as a combat soldier in Vietnam.

It says that before entering the Assembly he was in-house counsel for his family's business, Certo Brothers Distributing Co., a county assistant district attorney, counsel to Niagara Falls Community Development and a business-law attorney.
He served as Niagara Falls City Court Judge from 2001 to 2015, according to the biography.

The biography says he is committed to reforming Albany and addressing what it calls a culture of corruption in state government, and that he will work to implement workforce development programs, create more jobs and address the impact of drugs and violence on New York's families.
